# appwrite_project_ephemeral_key (Ephemeral Resource)

Mints a short-lived, scoped Appwrite project API key that is never written to Terraform state. The key cannot be revoked -- it is a signed token the server does not store -- so it stays valid until `duration_seconds` elapses. Ask for the shortest duration and the narrowest scopes the run needs.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scopes` (Set of String) The permission scopes granted to the key. Grant only what the run needs.

### Optional

- `duration_seconds` (Number) How long the key remains valid, in seconds. Defaults to 3600, which is also the maximum the server allows. The key cannot be revoked early, so prefer the shortest duration that covers the run.
- `project_id` (String) The Appwrite project ID. Defaults to the provider-level project_id.

### Read-Only

- `expire` (String) The key expiration timestamp in ISO 8601 format.
- `id` (String) The key ID.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The key secret. Pass this to a downstream provider or write-only argument.
